question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        MIN(lt.term_start)::DATE as first_term_start,
        lt.state,
        l.gender
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, lt.state, l.gender
),
time_points AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, state, gender, 0 as interval_years FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, state, gender, 2 FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, state, gender, 4 FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, state, gender, 6 FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, state, gender, 8 FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, state, gender, 10 FROM first_terms
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        tp.id_bioguide,
        tp.first_term_start,
        tp.state,
        tp.gender,
        tp.interval_years,
        (DATE_TRUNC('year', tp.first_term_start + (tp.interval_years || ' years')::INTERVAL) + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE as target_dec31
    FROM time_points tp
),
serving AS (
    SELECT 
        rc.id_bioguide,
        rc.state,
        rc.gender,
        rc.interval_years,
        rc.target_dec31,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = rc.id_bioguide
            AND lt.term_start::DATE <= rc.target_dec31
            AND lt.term_end::DATE > rc.target_dec31
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_retained
    FROM retention_check rc
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        interval_years,
        COUNT(*) as total_legislators,
        SUM(is_retained) as retained_count,
        1.0 * SUM(is_retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM serving
    GROUP BY state, gender, interval_years
),
male_nonzero AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM retention_rates
    WHERE gender = 'M'
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING MIN(CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
       AND COUNT(*) = 6
),
female_nonzero AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM retention_rates
    WHERE gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING MIN(CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
       AND COUNT(*) = 6
)
SELECT m.state
FROM male_nonzero m
JOIN female_nonzero f ON m.state = f.state
ORDER BY m.state
